description: RNX-27 retrieval check set: a small test knowledge base (one chunk per answer plus distractors) and questions, half Indonesian and half English, each with the chunk that must be in the top 5 of the real search path. Vectors are in retrieval-check-vectors.json.

chunks.content: To create an API key, open Settings, choose API Keys and press Create key. The full key is shown only once, so copy it right away.
Credits are deducted after each model call, based on the tokens used and the tier of the model. Your balance is shown on the Billing page.
A workspace owner invites members by email from the Members tab; a workspace invitation stays valid for seven days.
You can upload Markdown files to a knowledge base; each file is split into chunks by heading and every chunk is embedded for search.
Untuk mengatur ulang kata sandi, buka halaman masuk, pilih Lupa kata sandi, lalu ikuti tautan yang dikirim ke email Anda.
Paket Enterprise memungkinkan kolaborasi workspace hingga seratus anggota dan memberikan kredit bulanan yang lebih besar.
Agen AI dapat dihubungkan ke kanal WhatsApp atau Telegram melalui menu Kanal pada halaman pengaturan agen.
Riwayat percakapan disimpan selama sembilan puluh hari; setelah itu percakapan lama dihapus secara otomatis.
The landing page lists the product features and links to the pricing table.
Model tiers group the available models by price; a higher tier costs more credits per token.
Workspace members can see the shared agents and the shared knowledge bases of that workspace.
Halaman tagihan menampilkan saldo kredit dan riwayat pembelian paket Anda.
Agen dapat memakai basis pengetahuan untuk menjawab pertanyaan pelanggan.
Email verifikasi dikirim setelah pendaftaran; tautan verifikasi berlaku selama satu hari.
